decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already replaces the approved FAQ with the complete revised copy, including the active-ticket transfer statement; no additional FAQ-state change is required.
Transferring active prize tickets with an NFT does not change which counters, badges, or referral-code attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
The active-ticket transfer rule does not change the selected Base network or deployment scope.
The transfer of active prize tickets does not alter the amount, structure, disclosure, or enforcement of the secondary-sale royalty.
The source changes ticket ownership upon NFT transfer, not ticket eligibility, expiration, carry-forward, or post-draw reset behavior governed by this Requirement.
The added active-ticket transfer rule does not change the NFT token serial's role, permanence, or display locations as the referral code.
The source does not change the commission amount or allocation to a random existing NFT holder when no referral code is supplied.
The active-ticket transfer rule does not change badge award thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment behavior.
The source governs ownership of already-active tickets after transfer and does not change the recipient or ticket quantities issued by a coded referral mint.
The source does not change the number or random-recipient allocation of tickets for a mint without a referral code.
Transferring active tickets does not change the manual one-click prize-claim flow or Winners page claim surface.
The NFT transfer treatment of active prize tickets does not affect the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion asset, or wallet requirements for fiat minting.
